New Year's Eve Transportation Scottsdale & Phoenix: Complete Party Guide

New Year's Eve turns Scottsdale and Phoenix into celebration central. Black-tie galas at the resorts, packed clubs in Old Town, fireworks over Tempe Town Lake. The one constant is that you need a plan for getting home safely and in style. Here it is, with the vehicles and rates we actually book.

Why NYE Transportation Matters

The Reality

  • The rideshare fare is whatever the app says at midnight, and waits run an hour or more
  • DUI checkpoints operate across the Valley
  • It is the highest-risk night of the year on the road

The Solution

A professional, licensed chauffeur means a pre-arranged pickup, an hourly rate quoted in writing when you book, door-to-door service and a celebration that does not have to end at midnight.

Top New Year's Eve Experiences

Resort Galas

The Valley's finest resorts host legendary celebrations:

  • The Phoenician: Black-tie gala, live entertainment, champagne toast and fireworks. Luxury SUV for couples and small groups.
  • Fairmont Scottsdale Princess: Multiple venues, world-class entertainment. Door-to-door elegance.
  • Arizona Biltmore: Historic setting, themed parties and a midnight countdown.
  • JW Marriott Desert Ridge: Family-friendly options plus adult celebrations and fireworks. Executive Sprinter for a multi-generational group.

Old Town Scottsdale

The epicenter of Arizona nightlife explodes on NYE. The venues cluster on and around Scottsdale Road. For groups, the Party Bus (28 Pax) or Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter gives you venue-to-venue flexibility and a vehicle positioned nearby at midnight.

Downtown Phoenix

A growing celebration scene of rooftop patios, cocktail rooms and music halls around Roosevelt Row. The Luxury SUV handles downtown streets easily.

Tempe Town Lake Fireworks

Arizona's largest public NYE celebration: a big fireworks show, live entertainment, food vendors and a family-friendly crowd. The Executive Sprinter gets a group in and out without the parking chaos.

Celebration Plans and What They Cost

The Couple's Champagne Evening (Luxury SUV)

  • 8:00 PM: Scottsdale hotel pickup
  • 8:30 PM: Dinner at Steak 44
  • 10:30 PM: Resort gala or nightclub arrival
  • 12:00 AM: Midnight toast
  • 3:00 AM: Safe return

Seven hours requested earns 1 free hour and bills 6: $750 before tax, $810 with tax.

The Friend Group Party (Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter)

  • 7:30 PM: Central pickup
  • 8:00 PM: Pre-party dinner
  • 10:00 PM: Old Town Scottsdale
  • 12:30 AM: After-party location
  • 2:30 AM: Returns

Seven hours requested bills 6: $1,500 before tax, $1,620 with tax. Twelve friends pay about $125 each; a full 15 pay about $100 each.

The Epic Party Bus Night (Party Bus (28 Pax))

  • 7:00 PM: Home pickups
  • 7:30 PM: Restaurant
  • 9:30 PM: Old Town entry
  • 11:45 PM: Midnight destination
  • 1:00 AM: Leisurely return

Six hours is $1,500 before tax, $1,620 with tax. Twenty guests pay $75 each; a full 28 pay about $54 each.

The Big Crowd (56-Passenger Motorcoach)

Eight hours on the 56-Passenger Motorcoach bills 7 hours: $2,275 before tax, $2,457 with tax, about $41 per person with 56 aboard. It has forward-facing rows rather than a party cabin — that is the trade for twice the seats.

The Resort Gala Run (Executive Sprinter)

Evening drop at the resort, a midnight (or later) pickup and a safe return for a group of up to 14. A 6-hour booking is $870 before tax, $940 with tax, about $62 per person.

Drinking on Board

Yes, adults can drink on board. Arizona's open-container law, A.R.S. § 4-251, exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine. It is BYOB, everyone drinking must be 21 or older, and the driver never drinks. If anyone on board is under 21, no alcohol at all. You can read the full explainer.

Venue-by-Venue Transportation Tips

Old Town Scottsdale

Drop near the 5th Avenue area, meet at a pre-arranged pickup spot (street pickups are chaos after midnight), arrive before 10 PM for the best entry, and let your chauffeur position nearby for a quick exit.

Downtown Phoenix

Drop near Central and Washington, pick up at a designated spot away from the crowds. The exit is easier than Old Town after midnight.

Resort Galas

Drop at the valet, pick up at the same valet on a timed plan. Departures are staggered and your chauffeur waits.

Tempe Town Lake

Drop south of the lake, pick up away from the pedestrian zones. Arrive early and expect gridlock on the way out.

Safety First

Arizona takes NYE DUI enforcement seriously: checkpoints Valley-wide, zero tolerance and consequences that follow you for years. Our promise is simple. A professional, licensed chauffeur who does not drink, continuous service until the last drop-off and no judgment about a change of plans at 1 AM.

What Is Included

Every booking includes a professional, licensed chauffeur, door-to-door service, bottled water, phone charging and flexible timing inside your booked hours. Ask about extended hours, and bring your own champagne (21 and over) for the midnight toast.

Alternative Celebrations

Not the nightclub type? We cover intimate dinners with a later pickup, private house parties with multiple pickups and safe returns, concerts and shows with a dinner stop, and a midnight toast at a desert or mountain lookout.
